arguments.title: Export the dashboard table as CSV
arguments.body:
## Problem
Finance needs the dashboard table every month, and there is no way to download it.

## Proposal
Export the current dashboard table as a CSV file. The visible columns alone would do.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Add an Export CSV action to the dashboard table.
2. Write the visible columns and rows, in their current order, to a CSV file.
3. Name the file after the dashboard so monthly exports are easy to tell apart.

## Acceptance
- [ ] The dashboard can export its current table as a CSV file
- [ ] The file holds the visible columns, in the order shown
- [ ] An empty table exports a file with just the header row

## Context
No related issue was found. Per `docs/plans/exports.md`, CSV export from dashboard tables is already planned, starting with the visible columns. Open question: should hidden columns be offered later?
